cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline, safety-constrained debugging assistance for students and developers using budget laptops with unreliable connectivity.

test_prompts.prompt:
Evidence: .env.local sets API_PORT=3000; the process environment contains an empty API_PORT; the application reports an invalid port. Return exactly four lines and no other text:
FINDING: <one local cause>
LOCAL ACTION: <one safe local action>
VERIFY: <one local check>
FETCH STATUS: no-fetch
Replace the angle-bracket text. Do not download or install anything.

Evidence: system Python raises ModuleNotFoundError for requests; .venv/bin/python reports requests is already installed. Return exactly four lines and no other text:
FINDING: <one local cause>
LOCAL ACTION: <use the existing virtual environment>
VERIFY: <one local check>
FETCH STATUS: no-fetch
Replace the angle-bracket text. Do not run pip install.
